text:
marisol: New tiny kit for managers — "Goal Friction Finder". 4 quick checks to spot goal problems before calibration. Copy/pasteable for 1:1s.

devin: love it. can you paste the checks?

marisol: 1) Outcome clarity — can you state what success looks like in one sentence? Example: "Increase daily active usage by 15% for our onboarding funnel". If not, add a metric.

marisol: 2) Dependency surface — list any teams or external blockers. Example: "Needs infra availability from infra-team v2 by Apr". If dependencies exist, add an owner + ETA.

marisol: 3) Time vs scope check — is this a committed vs stretch split? Mark items that are "must ship" vs "nice to have".

marisol: 4) Signal & measurement — what metric will you track weekly? Add the dashboard or query link.

devin: neat. any one-liners I can use in a 1:1 to reframe a messy goal?

marisol: quick manager lines you can paste:
- "Can you tell me the one metric we'll use to decide success here?"
- "Who else needs to be involved to make this happen by the target date?"
- "Which part of this is a commitment vs an experiment/stretch?"
- "What's the earliest signal we can look at to know this is working?"

kevin: can you give me self-review snippets for each failure mode? makes peer feedback easier.

marisol: sure, 1-liners for self-reviews:
- Outcome clarity: "I focused on retention but didn't align on the KPI; next cycle I'll define DAU lift as the primary metric and track weekly."
- Dependencies: "Blocked by infra delays; I coordinated with infra and captured an ETA, will escalate earlier next time."
- Time vs scope: "Delivered the committed subset; postponed two stretch items after triage with stakeholders."
- Signal: "Experiment lacked a clear success criteria; added dashboard and a weekly check-in for next run."

zoe: during calibration, is it ok to tweak IC wording or should we ask them to update first?

marisol: small clarity edits are fine (metric renames, grammar) — major changes to scope or outcomes should go back to the owner to confirm. Add an annotation in calibration notes when you edit.

hr-bot: :spiral_notepad: Kit uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/goal-friction-finder  — template + copy-paste 1:1 scripts. Pinned in #people-ops.

devin: thanks, will use in my 1:1s today :thumbsup:

marisol: awesome — happy to iterate if you find gaps. ping me or drop suggestions in the doc.
